about: Real answers from OpenAI Chat Completions to the prompts in server/src/admin/capability-translate.ts, with response_format json_schema, sent by the real route in createApp over the people and groups who-can.integration.test.ts seeds (Contractors, Engineering, Field Sales (EMEA), Sales, and two people in no group). Each string is the assistant message content exactly as the model returned it, recorded 2026-11-09. gpt-5.6-terra is the deployment default. readingCatchesInversion is gpt-4o-mini taking a literal request for a group's off switch and inverting it: on for Contractors, everybody else back to off. The changes check, because each is a switch the rule honours; the reading, which never saw the request, says what they do. No recording has a second attempt: across about twenty real calls, with and without the schema, neither model wrote a change the check refuses, so the retry is covered by the check's own test.
